description: This file defines a React component for a memory matching card game, including game logic, state management, and rendering.

methods.name: initializeGame
methods.description: Initializes the game by creating and shuffling pairs of cards, resetting states.

methods.name: handleCardClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking a card, managing flipped cards and move count.

methods.name: checkForMatch
methods.description: Checks if the two flipped cards match and updates matched cards list.

methods.name: handleGameComplete
methods.description: Handles actions when game is completed, calculates score, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state.

methods.name: isCardFlipped
methods.description: Returns whether a specific card is currently flipped or matched.

methods.name: isCardMatched
methods.description: Returns whether a specific card has been matched.
